claim.text: GELU does not cut at zero: a negative input still leaks through, unlike a hard cutoff.

spec.explain: From arXiv 1606.08415: toy GELU curve showing soft leak for x<0. Watch the gelu number: it stays small-negative instead of 0, unlike ReLU hard cutoff.

questions.q: What is gelu when x is -1?
Predict what happens to gelu when x moves to 2?
How does gelu at x = -2 compare to 0?
What value appears for gelu when x equals 0?
